name: MinePhone
tagline: A working phone for Minecraft: your own number, real voice calls, voicemail and texts with other players.
description: MinePhone gives every player a **working phone**. You get your own permanent 9 digit phone number tied to your Minecraft account, so nobody can pretend to be you, and you can call, leave voicemail and text other MinePhone players, in single player and on any server.

Press **K** (you can change the key in Controls) and the phone slides up from the bottom right of the screen. Press it again and it slides away. When a text or a call comes in, the top of the phone pops up for a few seconds so you can see who it is.

list: Your own phone number (9 digits with a check digit, so typos are caught), created in a short setup the first time you open the phone
Real voice calls over the internet, with a keypad, mute, in-call keypad and a list of recent calls with missed call badges
Voicemail, with a PIN you choose during setup
Text messages with unread counts, retry for failed texts and a sound when a new one arrives
Contacts: save people under any name you like, call or message them, and save someone straight from your recent calls
Contact cards: share your name and picture with a friend with one tap. Until you save someone or they share their contact, they only show as a number, so a number never gives away who owns it
Edit your display name and picture at any time (the name can change once a day)
Signal bars that follow your ping to the service, and "No Service" when it cannot be reached
Pick your own ringtone and message sound, or drop your own .mp3 or .wav files into the sounds folders
Keypad tones when you dial, a 12 hour or 24 hour clock, and the number on the home screen is hidden except for its first digit
Keybinds to answer (Y) and hang up (N) without opening the phone, all rebindable
A genuine, logged-in Minecraft account (the phone checks this with Mojang, so cracked clients cannot register)
An internet connection: calls, voicemail and texts go through the MinePhone service, so there is nothing to set up on servers
A microphone and speakers or a headset for calls
**Fabric** and **Fabric API**. Each download covers one range of Minecraft versions, so pick your version and the site gives you the right file
Texting and signing in only work with other MinePhone users, and each number belongs to one Minecraft account for good
Call audio is not encrypted yet (the connection setup is). Only call people you would talk to in public voice chat
Blocking is applied by the mod on your side. Blocked numbers cannot text you and their calls are declined
There is no echo cancellation, so a headset sounds much better than speakers
Some launchers ship a trimmed Java without audio support. If calls are silent, use a launcher with a full Java 21 or 25 runtime

changelog: Works on Minecraft 1.21.11, 26.1.x (26.1, 26.1.1 and 26.1.2), 26.2 and 26.3 with Fabric
Phone with calls, voicemail, texts, contacts and contact cards, profile editing, ping based signal bars, choosable ringtone and message sound, keypad tones and a 12 or 24 hour clock
